target.scope: Existing v3 owned namespace in a private frozen scene; one animal; unrelated wildlife excluded
target.mesh_audit: Two skinned meshes / 21504 vertices / 40208 faces / one 20-joint skeleton; no Icosphere present in the accepted composed asset. Revalidate composition in private fixture.

image_coordinates.raw_native_coordinates: Retain unchanged; inclusivity must be established with M2 fixtures before conversion

direct_geometry.source: Evaluated skinned render-purpose triangles with complete transforms at one simulation time
direct_geometry.clipping: Homogeneous frustum/near clipping required for crossing triangles; reject unsupported cases explicitly
direct_geometry.world_aabb_box: Separate provenance/name if used as diagnostic

identity.inherited_labels: Record actual mesh mappings; union only IDs resolving to the two owned render meshes, never all objects of the same class; no segmentation provider enablement occurred in M1

null_policy: Unavailable/unsupported results are null plus status/reason; never fake empty mask, zero visibility or physical absence
body_appearance: Direct and qualified transmitted/refracted body only; exclude reflections/shadows/glints/caustics/wakes
display: round(255*(max(rgb,0)/(1+max(rgb,0)))**(1/2.2)) with one fixed mapping; alpha excluded from RGB metrics

synchronisation.preferred: One product, one frame and immutable stage for HDR/EXR/mask; native frame key retained where supported
synchronisation.existing_gap: capture_hdr schedules inventory, float buffer and EXR separately; frame_info is received but discarded by existing inventory helper
synchronisation.fallback: Immutable state hash plus alternating-state stale-frame test; weaker guarantee explicitly reviewed, no fabricated frame IDs
synchronisation.time_owner: Explicit accepted simulation time; no timeline, network or settling-clock advancement
synchronisation.native_ids: Per-frame mapping normalized to instance identity for comparison only

compatibility: Existing HTTP endpoint schemas and previous annotations remain unchanged; no endpoint added during M1
